Disappointing Experience
Mar 2026 • Friends
I’ve eaten here, and first saw the food cooked with family rice, so I opted for a place to invite friends in the distance. But it was a very bad experience today. I ordered a few of them, which included crocodile ribs that I love. That’s with a sandwich. But when it comes out, the edges are as re-wrapped as the potato skulls are, they lose the purity of the watch. The sauce is sour and heated, but I still smell it from the day before. I told the staff, they ran out and bought new sandwiches and brought them back. If you don’t see an apology from the shop, I’ll probably come back next time. I posted a photo attached to it, looking at the bowl’s boring ribs, the same way the excess was recooked.
